CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.verificar_sou_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public."Administrador"
    WHERE auth_user_id = auth.uid()
      AND ativo = true
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION privado.iniciar_estoque_variacao()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO public."Estoque" (id_prd_fk, id_var_fk)
  VALUES (NEW.id_prd_fk, NEW.id_var);
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
gatilhos.definicao: CREATE TRIGGER iniciar_estoque_variacao AFTER INSERT ON public."Produto_Variacao" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION privado.iniciar_estoque_variacao()
